The backstory

The starting point

#HoySabes is an Instagram campaign about hidradenitis suppurativa, presented in Backstory’s credentials under SAD / AbbVie. The project addresses communication around a little-known disease.

The craft

The campaign combined advice developed by medical professionals with influencer participation. Its visual language and social content open an approachable conversation supported by specialist knowledge.

  • Influencer collaboration
